book.name: 2 Korinita
book.title: Korinita Lenji Leta Theghewoniye Pol Le Rorori

content: Kaiwae ghinda Loi le valɨrakakaiwo, wo ŋaevairɨŋga kaiwae va hu wo Loi le mwaewo bwagabwaga, thava i tabo bigi bwagabwaga e ghemi.
Kaiwae Loi iŋa:

content.text: “Wo mbaŋa thovuye e tɨne iyava ya woraweya lo renuwaŋa, ya loŋweya len naŋgo na va ya gharevɨrɨŋaŋge.
Na ya thalavuŋge e mbaŋako iyako va i vutha iya ya vamoruŋge.”

content: Wo hu vandeŋe! Mbaŋake iyake Loi le gharevɨrɨ ghambaŋa, noroke iye le vamoru ghambaŋa.
Pol gha vuyowo i woraŋgiya iye Loi le rakakaiwo
Ma nuwameiya lolo regha i wovatharɨtharɨŋa lama kaiwoke, iya kaiwae thava wo vakatha ghamba thalatɨva regha lolo regha e marae.
Ko iyemaeŋge e lama vakathake wolaghɨye tɨne wo woraŋgiyaime ghime Loi le rakakaiwo, mbaŋa vuyowo, vɨrɨ na gharɨgharɨ lenji vakatha raraitharɨ weime wo ghataŋaghathɨ.
Thɨ gabogaboŋaime, thɨ vaŋguraweime e thiyo, thɨ vakatha wabwi na thɨ vagegeime, wo kaiwo laghɨye moli, ma wo ghenevun; na bada i gharɨime.

Wo woraŋgiyaime ghime Loi le rakakaiwo, kaiwae ghamathanavu i rumwaru, e lama ghareghare Toto Thovuye kaiwae, wo rouda, ghamathanavu i thovuye weŋgiya ghamaune, Nyao Boboma i vavurɨghegheŋaime, wo gharethovuŋgi gharɨgharɨ,
wo utuutu emunjoru, na Loi ele vurɨgheghe tɨne wo kakaiwo. Thanavu rumwaru iye ŋgoreiya lama gaithɨ biginiye ina e nɨmameke unemeke na e moimeke.

E lama vakathake wolaghɨye tɨne wo woraŋgiyaime ghime Loi le rakakaiwo: Gharɨgharɨ vavana thɨ taraweime, na vavana thɨ yaŋgiwanaime; vavana thɨ utu vathara utuutunime na vavana thɨ wovathovuthovuyeŋaime. Gharɨgharɨ thɨŋava ghime rautukwanɨkwan, ko iyemaeŋge ghime rautuutu emunjoru moli;

thɨŋava ma e idaidame, ko iyemaeŋge gharɨgharɨ lemoyo thɨ ghareghareime; mbaŋake wolaghɨye wo yakuyaku mare ele valɨvaŋga, ko iyemaeŋge mbe e yawayawalime. Thɨ tagavakowanaime moli, ko iyemaeŋge ma thɨ tagavamareime.

Wo vaidiya nuwatharɨ, ko iyemaeŋge mbaŋake wolaghɨye wo warawarari; wo tabo mbinyembinyeŋgu, ko iyemaeŋge wo vakathaŋgiya gharɨgharɨ lemoyo thɨ vwenyevwenye; ma e lama bigibigi, ko iyemaeŋge wo riyevanjara e bigibigike wolaghɨye.
Ra yaku na ghamwanda vanaora
Ghemi Korinita, bigibigike wolaghɨye kaero wo utuvao weŋga, ma wo ravunyivunyi mun regha weŋga, na ghamigharethovu i laghɨye moli e gharemeke.
Ghami gharethovu e gharemeke ma e ghatagagana, ko ghemieŋge ghime ghamagharethovu e gharemina e ghatagagana.
Valɨkaiwae hu gharethovuime. Ya rorori ŋgoreiye ghemi lo gamagai.
Thava ra tubwe na regha weindaŋgiya thiye ma thɨ loŋweghathɨ
Thava weimiyaŋgiya thavala ma thɨ loŋweghathɨ hu kaiwo na regha o hu tubwe na regha. Thare valɨkaiwae thovuye na tharɨ thɨ kaiwo na regha? Thare valɨkaiwae manjamanjala na momouwo thɨ yaku na regha?
Thare valɨkaiwae Krais na Seitan thɨ vɨghathɨ? Thare valɨkaiwae raloŋweloŋweghathɨ na ma raloŋweghathɨ lenji renuwaŋa regha?
Thare valɨkaiwae Loi le Ŋgolo Boboma na loi vatavatad thɨ yaku na regha? Kaiwae ghinda Loi e yawayawaliye le ŋgolo, ŋgoreiya Loi ghamberegha va iŋa,

content.text: “Ne ya yaku weŋguyaŋgi na ya loŋgaloŋga e tɨnenji.
Ghino ya tabo lenji Loi na thiye thɨ tabona lo gharɨgharɨ.”

content: Loi mbowo iŋava,

content.text: “Iya kaiwae hu roiteteŋgi na hu meghaghathɨ.
The bigibigiya thɨ mbighɨ e maraŋgu thava hu vɨghathɨŋgi,
na mbala ya vaŋguvathaŋa e ghino.
Na ghino ghemi Ramami na ghemi ghino lo ŋgaŋga.”

content: Loi Vurɨvurɨghegheniye ghalɨŋaya iyako.
